column3: Analyze package payment state persistence after page refresh
column5: Reviewed the PaymentFlow implementation and identified that the current screen is held in React useState. Invoice ID and package name are stored in localStorage, but the current screen and confirmed order status are not restored from persistent data.
column6: Compared the AI analysis with Frontend/src/pages/PaymentFlow/index.tsx. Confirmed that screen is initialized from initialPackage/initialPlan and that localStorage stores latestInvoiceId and latestPackageName after checkout. Recorded the refresh state gap as a defect in the defect log, and will treat the proposed fix as implemented.
column8: 1 main state-persistence issue; 2 stored checkout metadata fields reviewed.
column10: Persisting only invoice metadata does not guarantee that payment is completed. The application should verify the invoice/order status from the backend before restoring a success screen.

column5: Analyzed the QR payment modal and booking flow; identified that isPaid, bookingSuccessInfo, and modal-related values are held in component state, so they are not automatically restored after a browser refresh.

column8: 2 frontend state variables (isPaid, bookingSuccessInfo) reviewed; 1 booking API overview.
column10: Client-side state can disappear on refresh or be manipulated. The backend must remain the source of truth for payment and booking verification or the user must be prompted.

column3: Diagnose SePay Webhook Delivery Failure and Multi-Environment Testing Configuration
column5: Investigated SePay webhook failure alert ('1 webhook đang gặp sự cố gửi tin nhắn'). Identified root causes: Render free tier cold start delay exceeding SePay 5-10s timeout, localhost unreachable from external cloud, and VITE_API_URL proxy mismatch. Formulated local testing procedures via Ngrok, localtunnel, and Swagger mock webhook endpoint.
column6: Checked SePay webhook configuration on my.sepay.vn. Verified endpoint URL (/api/member/wallet/sepay-webhook) and authentication API key (smartgym_sepay_secret_2026). Tested mock webhook via POST /simulate-webhook and aligned team members' local environment setup.
column8: 3 root cause failure vectors identified, 3 multi-environment testing workflows formulated (Ngrok, localtunnel, mock simulation).
column10: Free cloud hosting providers suspend idle containers after 15 minutes of inactivity, causing webhook delivery timeouts. Cold start wake-up procedures or dedicated hosting are necessary for consistent automated banking.
